attempts.summary: Configured OPNsense on node1 to publish node2's HTTP service (port 8080) on node1's own address (10.100.182.10) port 80 via a DNAT port-forward, with NAT reflection (hairpin) enabled so node3 reaches the service through node1's address rather than contacting node2 directly. Also had to stand up the HTTP service on node2 (it wasn't running) as a persistent systemd unit, and open firewalld port 8080. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot identity and full service/NAT recovery after each.
